body:
I kept the sealed seed packet you asked about. The trial crew passed near midnight; my brother started coughing, and only later a patrol turned everyone back.

We needed the supplies listed here for the following morning. The people who took the count left without asking whether we had them.

I do not know which of the two accounts was repeated afterward. The older one is the one I had in my hands that day.
title: Near midnight: sealed seed packet

body:
If they ask you who started it, tell them I went inside for the dog. I did. I also went back for the little box under the sink, the one with the dates written on the lid.

The men outside told me to leave it where it was. One held the door while the other watched me search. When I came out without it, they let me sit by the truck. They were careful with me then. They had already put the box in a bag of their own.

The dog came out through the back, singed and furious. Please give her water first. I don't want her remembered as another thing I left inside.
title: For the dog, if anyone asks
